{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Illegal drugs and alcohol abuse are closely related to the incidence of child abuse.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Government at all levels spends about $20 billion annually on programs to help either children or adults in abusive or neglectful families.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The largest federal effort is open-ended entitlements aimed at foster care and adoption.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Very little is allotted to preventive and family support services.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for decreasing abuse caseloads and increasing accountability throughout the child protection system.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Proposal to restructure the child protection system by combining separate and competing funding sources into a Child Protection Block Grant with guaranteed levels of funding.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Child Protection Block Grant will empower the states to respond more quickly, more flexibly, and with greater compassion to children in peril.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for the stringent and effective enforcement of laws against the abuse of children.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"For many children, adoption may be the only route to a stable and loving home.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for government at all levels working with charitable and faith-based groups that provide adoption services to remove obstacles they sometimes encounter in their efforts to unite children in need with families who need them.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
